READ	SELECT f1 - date '2000-01-01' AS `Days From 2K` FROM DATE_TBL
READ	SELECT f1 - date 'epoch' AS `Days From Epoch` FROM DATE_TBL
READ	SELECT date 'yesterday' - date 'today' AS `One day`
READ	SELECT date 'today' - date 'tomorrow' AS `One day`
READ	SELECT date 'yesterday' - date 'tomorrow' AS `Two days`
READ	SELECT date 'tomorrow' - date 'today' AS `One day`
READ	SELECT date 'today' - date 'yesterday' AS `One day`
READ	SELECT date 'tomorrow' - date 'yesterday' AS `Two days`
READ	select make_date(2013, 7, 15)
